blocks.zh: CGMP合規一般考量
blocks.en: General Considerations for CGMP Compliance

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「demonstrate compliance」在Part 4語境下的含義，以及精簡方式（streamlined approach）的範圍。
blocks.en: Understand what "demonstrate compliance" means in the context of Part 4, and the scope of the streamlined approach.

blocks.zh: 掌握各研究階段（Phase 1/2/3）對CGMP豁免的適用規則。
blocks.en: Master the rules on CGMP exemptions for each investigational phase (Phase 1/2/3).

blocks.zh: 區分「constituent part」、「component」、「container-closure」與「delivery device」四個關鍵術語。
blocks.en: Distinguish the four key terms "constituent part", "component", "container-closure" and "delivery device".

blocks.zh: 判斷哪些CGMP規定適用於特定產品或設施，包括「where appropriate」語言的處理。
blocks.en: Determine which CGMP provisions apply to a particular product or facility, including how to handle "where appropriate" language.

blocks.zh: 理解多設施製造中的合規協調責任，以及CAPA資訊流的要求。
blocks.en: Understand the responsibility for compliance coordination in multi-facility manufacturing, and the requirements for CAPA information flow.

blocks.zh: 掌握變更控制在組合產品跨成分影響評估中的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: Master the core logic of change control in assessing cross-constituent-part impact for combination products.

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 導論說明
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：本節範圍
blocks.en: Important reminder: scope of this section

blocks.zh: 本節僅討論CGMP要求。變更產品設計、預期用途或製造方式後，可能同時觸發上市前審查（premarket submission）義務。這兩者是平行義務，互不取代。
blocks.en: This section addresses CGMP requirements only. A change to product design, intended use or method of manufacture may also trigger premarket submission obligations. The two are parallel obligations and neither replaces the other.

blocks.zh: CDMO需特別注意：協助客戶進行組合產品製造時，若發生任何變更，必須同步評估CGMP合規與法規送件兩個面向。
blocks.en: CDMOs should take particular care: when supporting a client with combination product manufacturing, any change must be assessed for both CGMP compliance and regulatory submission.

blocks.zh: III.A Demonstrating Compliance — 合規展示
blocks.en: III.A Demonstrating Compliance

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 「Demonstrate」的標準
blocks.en: The standard for "demonstrate"

blocks.zh: 「demonstrate」一詞在Part 4的意義，與在底層CGMP法規（Parts 210/211、820等）中完全相同的標準——即製造商必須能夠向FDA稽查員證明其實際符合規定，而不僅是書面聲稱符合。
blocks.en: The word "demonstrate" in Part 4 carries exactly the same standard as in the underlying CGMP regulations (Parts 210/211, 820, etc.): the manufacturer must be able to prove to an FDA investigator that it actually complies, not merely claim compliance on paper.

blocks.zh: 精簡方式的要求結構
blocks.en: Requirement structure of the streamlined approaches

blocks.zh: 藥品CGMP為基礎的精簡方式：
blocks.en: Drug CGMP-based streamlined approach:

blocks.zh: 必須示範：全部適用的藥品CGMP（Parts 210/211）
blocks.en: Must demonstrate: all applicable drug CGMP (Parts 210/211)

blocks.zh: 額外示範：21 CFR 4.4(b)(2)指定的Part 820六項條款
blocks.en: Additionally demonstrate: the six Part 820 provisions specified in 21 CFR 4.4(b)(2)

blocks.zh: 不需示範：Part 820其他條款
blocks.en: Need not demonstrate: the other provisions of Part 820

blocks.zh: 器材QS法規為基礎的精簡方式：
blocks.en: Device QS regulation-based streamlined approach:

blocks.zh: 必須示範：全部適用的Part 820規定
blocks.en: Must demonstrate: all applicable Part 820 requirements

blocks.zh: 額外示範：21 CFR 4.4(b)(1)指定的Parts 210/211條款
blocks.en: Additionally demonstrate: the Parts 210/211 provisions specified in 21 CFR 4.4(b)(1)

blocks.zh: 不需示範：Parts 210/211其他條款
blocks.en: Need not demonstrate: the other provisions of Parts 210/211

blocks.zh: 衝突解決原則（21 CFR 4.4(e)）
blocks.en: Conflict resolution principle (21 CFR 4.4(e))

blocks.zh: 若不同法規間發生衝突，對特定成分最具針對性的規定優先適用（特別法優於一般法）。此條款目的是解決法規衝突，而非授權FDA要求製造商遵守Part 4以外額外規定。
blocks.en: If regulations conflict, the provision that is most specifically applicable to the constituent part in question governs (the specific overrides the general). The purpose of this provision is to resolve regulatory conflicts, not to authorize FDA to require manufacturers to comply with requirements beyond Part 4.

blocks.zh: 交叉引用條款的處理
blocks.en: Handling of cross-referenced provisions

blocks.zh: 比喻：法規的「引路石」
blocks.en: Analogy: the regulatory "signpost"

blocks.zh: 想像A法規提到「另見B法規」——這個交叉引用並不自動要求你也須「示範」B法規。FDA的立場是：只要你的整個體系（藥品CGMP或QS）實質上能達到B法規的目的，就算達標。
blocks.en: Imagine Regulation A says "see also Regulation B". This cross-reference does not automatically require you to also "demonstrate" compliance with Regulation B. FDA's position is that as long as your overall system (drug CGMP or QS) substantively achieves the purpose of Regulation B, you have met the requirement.

blocks.zh: 關鍵在於「實質等效性」，而非條文逐條對應。
blocks.en: The key is "substantive equivalence", not a clause-by-clause match.

blocks.zh: 三個典型例子
blocks.en: Three typical examples

blocks.zh: 211.170 → 211.192：備用樣品條款引用了生產記錄審查。以QS為基礎時，820.100（CAPA）涵蓋了生產記錄審查的實質要求。
blocks.en: 211.170 to 211.192: the reserve sample provision refers to production record review. Under the QS-based approach, 820.100 (CAPA) covers the substance of production record review.

blocks.zh: 211.103 → 211.68：產率計算引用了自動化設備。820.70(i)對自動化資料處理驗證有對應要求。
blocks.en: 211.103 to 211.68: yield calculation refers to automated equipment. 820.70(i) has a corresponding requirement for validation of automated data processing.

blocks.zh: 820.3（設計輸出）→ 820.181 DMR：211.186（MPCR）與820.181（DMR）在實質上是對齊的，兩套系統都要求主紀錄以控制產品開發與製造。
blocks.en: 820.3 (design output) to 820.181 DMR: 211.186 (MPCR) and 820.181 (DMR) are substantively aligned; both systems require a master record to control product development and manufacture.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 你的公司以藥品CGMP為基礎採用精簡方式。稽查員問你是否需要示範符合21 CFR 820.184（Device History Record, DHR）。
blocks.en: Your company has adopted the streamlined approach based on drug CGMP. An investigator asks whether you need to demonstrate compliance with 21 CFR 820.184 (Device History Record, DHR).

blocks.zh: 你的回答應該是什麼？請根據交叉引用原則思考，Part 211中有無實質等效的條款？
blocks.en: What should your answer be? Think it through using the cross-reference principle: is there a substantively equivalent provision in Part 211?

blocks.zh: III.B Investigational Products — 研究用產品
blocks.en: III.B Investigational Products

blocks.zh: 研究階段CGMP豁免總覽
blocks.en: Overview of CGMP exemptions by investigational phase

blocks.zh: 設計控制（820.30）永遠不豁免
blocks.en: Design controls (820.30) are never exempt

blocks.zh: 無論研究產品處於哪個階段，只要含有器材成分，21 CFR 820.30設計控制就必須適用（除非該器材成分本身根據產品分類豁免於設計控制）。
blocks.en: Whatever stage the investigational product is at, if it contains a device constituent part, the design controls in 21 CFR 820.30 must apply (unless the device constituent part is itself exempt from design controls under its product classification).

blocks.zh: 設計控制應在管理層決定繼續開發時立即啟動，而不是等到Phase 1完成後才開始。
blocks.en: Design controls should start as soon as management decides to proceed with development, not after Phase 1 is complete.

blocks.zh: 比喻：設計控制像建築藍圖
blocks.en: Analogy: design controls are like architectural blueprints

blocks.zh: 你不會等房子蓋到一半才畫藍圖。設計控制（Design Controls）就是在施工前建立的設計規格、驗證計畫與批准流程——越早開始，越能避免後期的設計變更成本。
blocks.en: You would not wait until a house is half built to draw the blueprints. Design controls are the design specifications, verification plans and approval processes established before construction begins; the earlier they start, the more you avoid costly design changes later.

blocks.zh: FDA明確說：「一旦管理層決定推進開發，設計控制就要啟動。」不是等臨床成功後再補。
blocks.en: FDA states explicitly: "Design controls should begin once management decides to proceed with development." They are not something to be added after clinical success.

blocks.zh: CDMO應用場景
blocks.en: CDMO application scenario

blocks.zh: CDMO承接客戶的Phase 1藥品製造：雖然Parts 210/211豁免，但FDA建議仍使用「適合研究產品的製造方法、設施與控制」，並考慮製造環境的潛在危害。
blocks.en: A CDMO takes on a client's Phase 1 drug manufacture: although Parts 210/211 are exempt, FDA recommends still using "manufacturing methods, facilities and controls suitable for investigational products" and considering the potential hazards of the manufacturing environment.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：即使在Phase 1豁免期，也應建立適合的品質管理基礎，以便Phase 2時能平順接軌完整CGMP要求。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: even during the Phase 1 exemption period, establish an appropriate quality management foundation so that the transition to full CGMP requirements at Phase 2 is smooth.

blocks.zh: III.C.1 "Manufacture" and "Manufacturer" — 製造與製造商
blocks.en: III.C.1 "Manufacture" and "Manufacturer"

blocks.zh: 「製造」的廣義定義
blocks.en: The broad definition of "manufacture"

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 4.2「Manufacture」定義範圍
blocks.en: Scope of the definition of "Manufacture" in 21 CFR 4.2

blocks.zh: Part 4的「製造」包含但不限於：
blocks.en: "Manufacture" under Part 4 includes, but is not limited to:

blocks.zh: 設計（Designing） — 最重要的擴展，見右側說明
blocks.en: Designing: the most important extension; see the explanation below

blocks.zh: 製作（Fabricating）、組裝（Assembling）
blocks.en: Fabricating and assembling

blocks.zh: 填充（Filling）、加工（Processing）
blocks.en: Filling and processing

blocks.zh: 測試（Testing）、貼標（Labeling）
blocks.en: Testing and labeling

blocks.zh: 包裝（Packaging）、再包裝（Repackaging）
blocks.en: Packaging and repackaging

blocks.zh: 持有（Holding）與儲存（Storage）
blocks.en: Holding and storage

blocks.zh: 設計即製造 — 監管意涵
blocks.en: Design is manufacture: regulatory implications

blocks.zh: 這是高度重要的監管原則：即使你只負責設計，未實際生產任何東西，你仍然是Part 4下的「製造商」，必須遵守相應的CGMP要求。
blocks.en: This is a highly important regulatory principle: even if you are only responsible for design and never actually produce anything, you are still a "manufacturer" under Part 4 and must comply with the applicable CGMP requirements.

blocks.zh: 例如：一家專門開發藥物-器材組合產品設計的公司，其設計辦公室即為「製造設施」，即便所有實體製造都外包給其他廠商。
blocks.en: For example: a company that specializes in developing drug-device combination product designs has a design office that is a "manufacturing facility", even if all physical manufacturing is outsourced to other firms.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築師也是「建造者」
blocks.en: Analogy: the architect is also a "builder"

blocks.zh: 建築師只畫圖、不蓋樓，但法律上仍須對建築設計的安全性負責。Part 4下的「設計即製造」同理——設計決策決定了產品的安全有效性，因此設計活動受CGMP約束。
blocks.en: An architect only draws plans and does not build, but is still legally responsible for the safety of the building design. "Design is manufacture" under Part 4 works the same way: design decisions determine the safety and effectiveness of the product, so design activities are subject to CGMP.

blocks.zh: CDMO關鍵影響
blocks.en: Key implication for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 若CDMO為客戶提供設計服務（如協助設計prefilled syringe的填充與裝配參數，或協助客戶開發藥物與遞送器材的相容性規格），則該CDMO即成為Part 4下的製造商，須承擔相應的CGMP合規責任，不得以「我只是服務提供者，不是製造商」為由規避。
blocks.en: If a CDMO provides design services for a client (for example, helping to design the filling and assembly parameters of a prefilled syringe, or helping the client develop compatibility specifications between a drug and its delivery device), that CDMO becomes a manufacturer under Part 4 and must take on the corresponding CGMP compliance responsibility. It cannot avoid this by saying "we are only a service provider, not a manufacturer".

blocks.zh: III.C.2 "Constituent Part" vs. "Component" — 成分部分 vs 元件
blocks.en: III.C.2 "Constituent Part" vs. "Component"

blocks.zh: 術語辨析：三層結構
blocks.en: Distinguishing the terms: a three-tier structure

blocks.zh: 最重要的監管結論
blocks.en: The most important regulatory conclusions

blocks.zh: 僅製造器材元件（device components）的設施，Part 4不使其受到Part 820約束。
blocks.en: A facility that manufactures only device components is not made subject to Part 820 by Part 4.

blocks.zh: 僅製造API的設施，Part 4不使其受到Part 211約束。
blocks.en: A facility that manufactures only API is not made subject to Part 211 by Part 4.

blocks.zh: 觸發完整雙重義務的門檻是：你是否在生產「由元件組裝而成的完整組合產品」？若是，則須同時符合Parts 211與820。
blocks.en: The threshold that triggers the full dual obligation is: are you producing a "complete combination product assembled from components"? If so, both Parts 211 and 820 must be met.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車工廠 vs 零件廠
blocks.en: Analogy: car factory vs. parts factory

blocks.zh: 製造汽車引擎零件的工廠，不需要遵守汽車整車安全法規；只有最終組裝整車的工廠才須全面合規。
blocks.en: A factory that makes car engine parts does not need to comply with safety regulations for complete vehicles; only the factory that assembles the final vehicle must be fully compliant.

blocks.zh: 「Component manufacturer」≠「Constituent part manufacturer」——前者只負責下游原料，後者負責整個藥品或器材成品。
blocks.en: "Component manufacturer" is not the same as "constituent part manufacturer": the former is responsible only for downstream raw materials, the latter for the entire finished drug or device.

blocks.zh: CDMO常見混淆情境
blocks.en: Common points of confusion for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 客戶常問：「我們只幫你製造注射器活塞（piston）——是constituent part還是component？」
blocks.en: Clients often ask: "We only make the syringe piston for you. Is that a constituent part or a component?"

blocks.zh: 答案：注射器活塞是器材元件（device component），不是finished device。若你只製造活塞而不組裝成品器材，你的設施不受Part 820約束（但須受其他適用規範，如供應商資格要求等）。
blocks.en: Answer: a syringe piston is a device component, not a finished device. If you only make the piston and do not assemble a finished device, your facility is not subject to Part 820 (but it is still subject to other applicable requirements, such as supplier qualification requirements).

blocks.zh: III.C.3 Drug Containers & Closures vs. Delivery Devices — 容器封蓋 vs 遞送器材
blocks.en: III.C.3 Drug Containers & Closures vs. Delivery Devices

blocks.zh: 容器封蓋 vs 遞送器材
blocks.en: Container-closure vs. delivery device

blocks.zh: 預填充注射器（PFS）永遠是組合產品
blocks.en: A prefilled syringe (PFS) is always a combination product

blocks.zh: PFS同時「持有」（container/closure）並「遞送」（delivery device）藥品，因此永遠是drug-device combination product，必須同時符合Parts 210/211和Part 820相關要求。
blocks.en: A PFS both "holds" the drug (container/closure) and "delivers" it (delivery device), so it is always a drug-device combination product and must meet the relevant requirements of both Parts 210/211 and Part 820.

blocks.zh: 這對無菌充填CDMO極為重要——若你的客戶在PFS中灌裝藥品，你就在生產組合產品，必須有完整的雙軌CGMP體系。
blocks.en: This matters greatly for aseptic fill-finish CDMOs: if your client has you fill drug into a PFS, you are producing a combination product and must have a complete dual-track CGMP system.

blocks.zh: 比喻：水杯 vs 飲水機
blocks.en: Analogy: drinking glass vs. water dispenser

blocks.zh: 水杯只是「持有」水，等你自己喝。飲水機「主動遞送」水給你。前者是容器，後者是設備。
blocks.en: A glass only "holds" the water until you drink it yourself. A water dispenser "actively delivers" water to you. The former is a container; the latter is a device.

blocks.zh: PFS就像「附有自動推進機構的水杯」——它不只盛裝藥品，還主動協助注射，因此具有器材功能。
blocks.en: A PFS is like "a glass with a built-in pushing mechanism": it not only holds the drug but also actively assists the injection, and therefore has a device function.

blocks.zh: 器材豁免的兩個條件（關鍵）
blocks.en: Two conditions for the device exemption (critical)

blocks.zh: 即使某器材依產品分類豁免於Part 820，若被整合到容器封蓋系統中（如把滴管蓋整合進瓶蓋），這可能構成「新用途」，使豁免失效。
blocks.en: Even if a device is exempt from Part 820 under its product classification, integrating it into a container-closure system (for example, building a dropper into a bottle cap) may constitute a "new intended use" and void the exemption.

blocks.zh: 任何豁免主張都必須書面記錄評估過程。不確定時，FDA建議諮詢lead center或OCP。
blocks.en: Any claim of exemption must be supported by a documented assessment. When in doubt, FDA recommends consulting the lead center or the OCP.

blocks.zh: 實務思考練習
blocks.en: Practical exercise

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO客戶要求你在一個特殊設計的「智能注射裝置」（含電子計量模組）中填充生物製品。
blocks.en: Your CDMO client asks you to fill a biologic into a specially designed "smart injection device" (containing an electronic dosing module).

blocks.zh: 這是combination product嗎？
blocks.en: Is this a combination product?

blocks.zh: 需要符合哪些CGMP規定？
blocks.en: Which CGMP requirements must be met?

blocks.zh: 設計控制（820.30）是否適用？
blocks.en: Do design controls (820.30) apply?

blocks.zh: III.C.4 Convenience Kits — 便利套組
blocks.en: III.C.4 Convenience Kits

blocks.zh: 便利套組的嚴格條件
blocks.en: Strict conditions for convenience kits

blocks.zh: Convenience Kit的兩個充分必要條件
blocks.en: The two necessary and sufficient conditions for a convenience kit

blocks.zh: 獨立合法上市：套組中每個產品必須是已在市場上獨立販售的合法上市產品。
blocks.en: Independently marketed legally: each product in the kit must already be a legally marketed product sold independently on the market.

blocks.zh: 原樣包裝：每個產品必須與其獨立上市時完全相同（包含標示內容），不得有任何再包裝、再標示或修改。
blocks.en: Packaged as is: each product must be exactly the same as when marketed independently (including labeling), with no repackaging, relabeling or modification of any kind.

blocks.zh: 只要這兩個條件同時成立，套組製造商只需對「組裝、包裝、貼標、滅菌等套組製造活動本身」負CGMP責任，不需承擔各成分的完整CGMP義務。
blocks.en: As long as both conditions are met, the kit manufacturer is responsible for CGMP only for "the kitting activities themselves, such as assembly, packaging, labeling and sterilization", and does not assume the full CGMP obligations for each constituent part.

blocks.zh: 失去Convenience Kit資格的情況
blocks.en: Situations that lose convenience kit status

blocks.zh: 任何成分被再包裝（repackaged）
blocks.en: Any constituent is repackaged

blocks.zh: 任何成分被再標示（relabeled）
blocks.en: Any constituent is relabeled

blocks.zh: 任何成分有其他形式的修改
blocks.en: Any constituent is modified in any other way

blocks.zh: 套組標示改變了任何成分的預期用途
blocks.en: The kit labeling changes the intended use of any constituent

blocks.zh: 套組引入了新的滅菌過程，改變了產品的使用環境
blocks.en: The kit introduces a new sterilization process that changes the conditions of use of the product

blocks.zh: 一旦失去Convenience Kit資格，製造商須承擔全套成分CGMP責任。
blocks.en: Once convenience kit status is lost, the manufacturer takes on the full CGMP responsibility for all constituents.

blocks.zh: 比喻：超市禮盒 vs 特製禮盒
blocks.en: Analogy: supermarket gift basket vs. custom gift set

blocks.zh: 超市把三瓶已上市的現成醬油用一個籃子裝起來送禮（原樣），這是Convenience Kit——你只須確保籃子品質，不須重新驗證每瓶醬油。
blocks.en: A supermarket puts three bottles of already-marketed soy sauce into a basket as a gift (as is). This is a convenience kit: you only need to make sure the basket is of good quality and do not need to revalidate each bottle of soy sauce.

blocks.zh: 但若你把醬油重新分裝成小瓶，或加印客製化標籤，就不再是Convenience Kit——你現在負責了那瓶醬油的全部。
blocks.en: But if you repackage the soy sauce into small bottles, or print custom labels, it is no longer a convenience kit: you are now responsible for everything about that soy sauce.

blocks.zh: 滅菌相容性考量（套組製造商必知）
blocks.en: Sterilization compatibility considerations (essential for kit manufacturers)

blocks.zh: 即使是Convenience Kit，若對整組進行滅菌（如環氧乙烷、輻射），必須評估：
blocks.en: Even for a convenience kit, if the whole kit is sterilized (for example by ethylene oxide or radiation), you must evaluate:

blocks.zh: 某些器材可承受輻射滅菌，但許多藥品不行
blocks.en: Some devices can withstand radiation sterilization, but many drugs cannot

blocks.zh: 再滅菌（re-sterilization）對穩定性、效期、材料特性的影響
blocks.en: The effect of re-sterilization on stability, expiration dating and material properties

blocks.zh: 滅菌過程對各成分的交叉影響（如包裝材料的揮發物影響藥品）
blocks.en: Cross-effects of the sterilization process on the constituents (for example, volatiles from packaging materials affecting the drug)

blocks.zh: 滅菌確效（validation）必須涵蓋套組中的每個成分
blocks.en: Sterilization validation must cover every constituent in the kit

blocks.zh: CDMO場景應用
blocks.en: CDMO application scenario

blocks.zh: 客戶請你為其醫院手術套組（surgical kit）做最終包裝並滅菌。套組包含：一瓶已上市消毒藥液 + 一個已上市手術刀盤。
blocks.en: A client asks you to do the final packaging and sterilization of its hospital surgical kit. The kit contains one bottle of an already-marketed antiseptic solution and one already-marketed scalpel tray.

blocks.zh: 判斷：若兩者都維持原包裝且不改標示，你可以主張Convenience Kit，但仍須確認：(1) 滅菌製程對兩者均安全；(2) 滅菌確效涵蓋整組；(3) 整個判斷過程有書面記錄。
blocks.en: Assessment: if both remain in their original packaging with unchanged labeling, you can claim convenience kit status, but you must still confirm that: (1) the sterilization process is safe for both; (2) the sterilization validation covers the whole kit; (3) the entire assessment is documented.

blocks.zh: III.D What CGMP Requirements Apply? — 哪些CGMP適用？
blocks.en: III.D What CGMP Requirements Apply?

blocks.zh: 按產品與設施活動判斷適用性
blocks.en: Determining applicability by product and facility activity

blocks.zh: 「適用性」的兩個維度
blocks.en: Two dimensions of "applicability"

blocks.zh: 產品層次（Product-level）：某些CGMP規定只適用於特定類型的產品。例如：
blocks.en: Product-level: some CGMP provisions apply only to specific types of product. For example:

blocks.zh: 防止篡改包裝要求 → 只適用於OTC組合產品
blocks.en: Tamper-evident packaging requirements: apply only to OTC combination products

blocks.zh: 安裝與服務要求（820.170/820.200） → 只適用於需安裝/維修的器材
blocks.en: Installation and servicing requirements (820.170/820.200): apply only to devices that require installation or servicing

blocks.zh: 血液CGMP（Part 606） → 只適用於血液製品
blocks.en: Blood CGMP (Part 606): applies only to blood products

blocks.zh: 設施層次（Facility-level）：某個設施只執行部分製造活動，只須符合與該活動相關的CGMP規定。
blocks.en: Facility-level: a facility that performs only some manufacturing activities need only meet the CGMP provisions relevant to those activities.

blocks.zh: 實務推論
blocks.en: Practical inferences

blocks.zh: 若你的CDMO設施從客戶處接收「已完成並包裝」的藥品成分，只負責將其組裝進套組：
blocks.en: If your CDMO facility receives "finished and packaged" drug constituents from the client and is only responsible for assembling them into a kit:

blocks.zh: 你不須為該藥品重新計算產率（yield calculation）
blocks.en: You do not need to recalculate the yield for that drug

blocks.zh: 你只須符合組裝、包裝、貼標等你實際執行的活動相關CGMP
blocks.en: You need only meet the CGMP relevant to the activities you actually perform, such as assembly, packaging and labeling

blocks.zh: 「我做什麼，就符合那部分的CGMP」——活動範圍決定合規範圍。
blocks.en: "I comply with the CGMP for what I do": the scope of activity determines the scope of compliance.

blocks.zh: 「Where Appropriate」的正確解讀
blocks.en: Correct interpretation of "where appropriate"

blocks.zh: 預設立場：適用，除非能舉證
blocks.en: Default position: applicable unless you can justify otherwise

blocks.zh: 「Where appropriate」不是免死金牌。FDA的解讀是：
blocks.en: "Where appropriate" is not a free pass. FDA's interpretation is:

blocks.zh: 凡有「where appropriate」字眼的規定，預設為適用
blocks.en: Any provision containing the words "where appropriate" is applicable by default

blocks.zh: 製造商可以不執行，但必須有書面記錄的正當理由
blocks.en: A manufacturer may choose not to implement it, but must have a documented justification

blocks.zh: 理由必須說明：「為何不執行不會影響產品符合規格要求」
blocks.en: The justification must explain "why not implementing it does not affect the product's ability to meet its specified requirements"

blocks.zh: 換言之：你可以不做，但你必須能解釋為什麼不做不會有問題。
blocks.en: In other words: you may leave it out, but you must be able to explain why leaving it out causes no problem.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「在必要時使用安全帽」
blocks.en: Analogy: "wear a hard hat where necessary"

blocks.zh: 工地規定「在必要時配戴安全帽」。如果你不戴，必須能說明「這個區域無墜物風險，因此不必要」，而不能只說「規定說『必要時』，所以我覺得不必要」。
blocks.en: A construction site rule says "wear a hard hat where necessary". If you do not wear one, you must be able to explain that "there is no falling-object risk in this area, so it is not necessary", and cannot simply say "the rule says 'where necessary', so I felt it was not necessary".

blocks.zh: CGMP中的「where appropriate」同理——負舉證責任的是你，不是FDA。
blocks.en: "Where appropriate" in CGMP works the same way: the burden of proof is on you, not on FDA.

blocks.zh: 設計變更確認 vs 驗證（820.30(i)範例）
blocks.en: Design change: verification vs. validation (example under 820.30(i))

blocks.zh: 材料規格的尺寸公差變更 → 通常可透過量測驗收（verification）而無需完整確效（validation）。
blocks.en: A change to the dimensional tolerance in a material specification: can usually be handled through measurement-based verification without full validation.

blocks.zh: 使用者介面的操作流程變更 → 影響使用者需求，通常需要使用者研究或可用性驗證（validation）。
blocks.en: A change to the operating workflow of the user interface: affects user needs and usually requires user studies or usability validation.

blocks.zh: 關鍵問題：這個變更是否影響使用者需求或安全有效性？影響則需確效；不影響則可用驗收代替，但仍需記錄理由。
blocks.en: Key question: does the change affect user needs or safety and effectiveness? If yes, validation is needed; if not, verification may be used instead, but the rationale must still be documented.

blocks.zh: 多設施製造：責任分配與協調
blocks.en: Multi-facility manufacturing: allocating responsibility and coordination

blocks.zh: Owner的「整體責任」不因外包而消失
blocks.en: The owner's "overall responsibility" does not disappear through outsourcing

blocks.zh: 即使上市許可持有人將全部製造外包，其對整個組合產品的CGMP合規負有最終責任。外包不等於轉移責任。
blocks.en: Even if the marketing authorization holder outsources all manufacturing, it bears ultimate responsibility for CGMP compliance of the entire combination product. Outsourcing does not transfer responsibility.

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）是管理此責任的關鍵工具。協議應明確：誰負責哪些製造活動、誰維護哪些文件、如何報告變更等。
blocks.en: The Quality Agreement is the key tool for managing this responsibility. It should state clearly who is responsible for which manufacturing activities, who maintains which documents, how changes are reported, and so on.

blocks.zh: CAPA跨設施資訊流
blocks.en: CAPA information flow across facilities

blocks.zh: 若設施A的不符合品數據顯示需要設計變更，而設計控制由設施B負責——CAPA系統必須能讓這個資訊流從A到B，並確保B能啟動適當的設計變更流程。
blocks.en: If nonconformance data at Facility A shows that a design change is needed, and design controls are the responsibility of Facility B, the CAPA system must allow this information to flow from A to B and ensure that B can start the appropriate design change process.

blocks.zh: 可以是：(1) 共用CAPA系統；或 (2) 各設施獨立CAPA系統 + 已建立的連結機制（如定期聯合審查、電子化資料介接等）。
blocks.en: This can be: (1) a shared CAPA system; or (2) independent CAPA systems at each facility plus an established linking mechanism (such as regular joint reviews or electronic data interfaces).

blocks.zh: FDA要求的是「adequate flow of information between facilities」，不要求一定要用哪種系統架構。
blocks.en: What FDA requires is an "adequate flow of information between facilities"; it does not require any particular system architecture.

blocks.zh: CDMO實務：品質協議的核心內容
blocks.en: CDMO practice: core content of the Quality Agreement

blocks.zh: 當CDMO承接組合產品的任何製造活動，品質協議應涵蓋：
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on any manufacturing activity for a combination product, the Quality Agreement should cover:

blocks.zh: 各方執行的具體製造活動清單與CGMP責任歸屬
blocks.en: A list of the specific manufacturing activities performed by each party and the allocation of CGMP responsibilities

blocks.zh: 設計控制文件的存取權與保管責任
blocks.en: Access to, and custody responsibility for, design control documents

blocks.zh: 供應商/原料變更的通知機制
blocks.en: Notification mechanism for supplier/raw material changes

blocks.zh: 不符合品、申訴與CAPA的跨設施處理流程
blocks.en: Cross-facility handling process for nonconformances, complaints and CAPA

blocks.zh: 稽查安排（包括允許客戶/Owner稽查CDMO）
blocks.en: Audit arrangements (including allowing the client/owner to audit the CDMO)

blocks.zh: 合約測試設施的文件存取安排
blocks.en: Document access arrangements for contract testing facilities

blocks.zh: III.E Control of Changes to a Combination Product — 組合產品的變更控制
blocks.en: III.E Control of Changes to a Combination Product

blocks.zh: 跨成分變更控制：CDMO的關鍵風險
blocks.en: Cross-constituent-part change control: a key risk for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 組合產品變更控制的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core logic of change control for combination products

blocks.zh: 組合產品的特殊之處在於：一個成分的變更，可能對另一個成分的安全有效性造成影響。
blocks.en: What is special about combination products is that a change to one constituent part may affect the safety and effectiveness of another constituent part.

blocks.zh: 這意味著變更評估必須是「跨成分的」，而不僅是「本成分內部的」。光是自己的品質體系通過了變更評估還不夠——必須確認另一個成分也沒有問題。
blocks.en: This means change assessment must be "cross-constituent-part" and not only "within this constituent part". It is not enough that your own quality system has passed the change assessment; you must confirm that the other constituent part is also unaffected.

blocks.zh: 比喻：相互咬合的齒輪
blocks.en: Analogy: interlocking gears

blocks.zh: 藥品成分與器材成分就像兩個咬合的齒輪。你改變其中一個齒輪的大小或齒距，另一個齒輪也必須相應調整，否則整個系統就會卡住或空轉。
blocks.en: The drug constituent part and the device constituent part are like two meshing gears. If you change the size or pitch of one gear, the other must be adjusted accordingly, or the whole system will jam or spin freely.

blocks.zh: 組合產品的變更控制，就是確保「齒輪咬合系統」在任何一方改變後，整體仍能安全運作。
blocks.en: Change control for a combination product ensures that the "meshing gear system" can still operate safely as a whole after either side changes.

blocks.zh: 供應商變更通知機制（21 CFR 820.50）
blocks.en: Supplier change notification mechanism (21 CFR 820.50)

blocks.zh: 製造商必須與供應商、承包商、顧問建立「變更通知」安排。關鍵是：
blocks.en: The manufacturer must establish "change notification" arrangements with suppliers, contractors and consultants. The key points are:

blocks.zh: 供應商改變其API配方、輔料、封蓋系統材料時，必須事先通知
blocks.en: When a supplier changes its API formulation, excipients or closure system materials, it must notify in advance

blocks.zh: 進料查驗程序必須能夠偵測並評估這些變更
blocks.en: Incoming inspection procedures must be able to detect and evaluate these changes

blocks.zh: 在納入成品前，必須先評估變更對組合產品安全有效性的影響
blocks.en: Before incorporation into the finished product, the effect of the change on the safety and effectiveness of the combination product must be evaluated

blocks.zh: 情境演練
blocks.en: Scenario drill

blocks.zh: 你的CDMO負責一個cross-labeled combination product的器材成分（autoinjector）製造。客戶（藥品持有人）通知你，他們的藥品製造商將把藥液黏度從2 cP調高到8 cP，以改善穩定性。
blocks.en: Your CDMO manufactures the device constituent part (an autoinjector) of a cross-labeled combination product. The client (the drug holder) notifies you that their drug manufacturer will raise the viscosity of the drug solution from 2 cP to 8 cP to improve stability.

blocks.zh: 這個藥品端的變更，對你的autoinjector設計有何潛在影響？
blocks.en: What potential effects does this drug-side change have on your autoinjector design?

blocks.zh: 你應該觸發什麼樣的設計控制評估？（參考820.30(i)）
blocks.en: What design control assessment should you trigger? (See 820.30(i).)

blocks.zh: 如何在品質協議中預先建立這樣的通知與評估機制？
blocks.en: How can you build such a notification and assessment mechanism into the Quality Agreement in advance?

blocks.zh: CDMO合規建議：跨成分變更管理SOP
blocks.en: CDMO compliance recommendation: SOP for cross-constituent-part change management

blocks.zh: CDMO應在其品質體系中建立「跨成分變更影響評估」的標準作業程序，至少涵蓋：
blocks.en: A CDMO should establish a standard operating procedure for "cross-constituent-part change impact assessment" in its quality system, covering at least:

blocks.zh: 收到客戶或供應商變更通知的接收與記錄流程
blocks.en: The process for receiving and recording change notifications from clients or suppliers

blocks.zh: 影響評估的判斷樹（對安全性、有效性、法規合規的影響）
blocks.en: A decision tree for impact assessment (impact on safety, effectiveness and regulatory compliance)

blocks.zh: 需升級通報的門檻定義（如：可能需要法規送件的變更）
blocks.en: Definition of thresholds for escalation (for example, changes that may require a regulatory submission)

blocks.zh: 與客戶共同確認設計規格仍適當的確認流程
blocks.en: A confirmation process with the client to verify that the design specifications remain appropriate

blocks.zh: 變更對效期/穩定性影響的評估觸發條件
blocks.en: Trigger conditions for assessing the effect of the change on expiration dating/stability

blocks.zh: Section III 總複習 — Key Takeaways for CDMO Practitioners
blocks.en: Section III Review: Key Takeaways for CDMO Practitioners

blocks.zh: 核心監管原則
blocks.en: Core regulatory principles

blocks.zh: Demonstrate（示範）：與底層CGMP法規相同的標準；精簡方式下只須示範特定條款，但「示範」的品質標準不降低。
blocks.en: Demonstrate: the same standard as the underlying CGMP regulations; under the streamlined approaches only specific provisions must be demonstrated, but the quality standard for "demonstrating" is not lowered.

blocks.zh: 研究階段豁免：藥品Phase 1豁免Parts 210/211；器材豁免Part 820但設計控制（820.30）永遠不豁免。
blocks.en: Investigational-phase exemptions: drugs are exempt from Parts 210/211 in Phase 1; devices are exempt from Part 820, but design controls (820.30) are never exempt.

blocks.zh: Constituent part ≠ Component：元件製造商（component manufacturer）不受Part 4約束；只有finished constituent part的製造商才受約束。
blocks.en: Constituent part is not a component: component manufacturers are not subject to Part 4; only manufacturers of finished constituent parts are.

blocks.zh: Hold vs. Deliver：僅持有藥品 = container/closure only；持有並遞送 = combination product，須符合Part 820。
blocks.en: Hold vs. Deliver: only holding the drug = container/closure only; holding and delivering = combination product, which must meet Part 820.

blocks.zh: Convenience Kit：嚴格條件（獨立上市＋原樣包裝）；任何修改均失去資格。
blocks.en: Convenience kit: strict conditions (independently marketed + packaged as is); any modification forfeits eligibility.

blocks.zh: Owner的整體責任：上市許可持有人即使外包全部製造，仍負最終CGMP責任。
blocks.en: Owner's overall responsibility: the marketing authorization holder retains ultimate CGMP responsibility even when all manufacturing is outsourced.

blocks.zh: 跨成分變更評估：一個成分的變更必須評估對其他成分的影響，品質協議是管理機制。
blocks.en: Cross-constituent-part change assessment: a change to one constituent part must be assessed for its effect on the other constituent parts; the Quality Agreement is the management mechanism.

blocks.zh: CDMO最高風險清單
blocks.en: List of highest CDMO risks

blocks.zh: 五大CDMO風險點
blocks.en: Five major CDMO risk points

blocks.zh: 設計服務即製造：若提供設計諮詢，即使不實際生產，也是Part 4下的製造商。
blocks.en: Design services are manufacture: if you provide design consulting, you are a manufacturer under Part 4 even if you produce nothing.

blocks.zh: PFS永遠是組合產品：承接PFS灌裝，必須有雙軌CGMP體系（藥品＋器材）。
blocks.en: A PFS is always a combination product: taking on PFS filling requires a dual-track CGMP system (drug + device).

blocks.zh: Convenience Kit資格誤判：再包裝或改標示後以為仍是Convenience Kit，可能面臨重大合規缺失。
blocks.en: Misjudging convenience kit eligibility: assuming a product is still a convenience kit after repackaging or relabeling can lead to major compliance deficiencies.

blocks.zh: CAPA資訊孤島：各設施CAPA系統未連結，導致跨設施問題無法有效處理。
blocks.en: CAPA information silos: unlinked CAPA systems across facilities mean cross-facility problems cannot be handled effectively.

blocks.zh: 供應商變更未通知：API或封蓋材料供應商變更未及時評估對器材端的影響。
blocks.en: Unnotified supplier changes: changes by API or closure material suppliers not promptly assessed for their effect on the device side.
